measurement_caveats: Whole-process wall time measured with perf_counter around subprocess.run, including imports, CUDA startup, checkpoint I/O and final rendering.
Runs were sequential. Background GPU utilization remained nonzero in driver snapshots despite no competing research GPU jobs.
The initial CPU samples were slower; all samples are retained. Cache effects and background load were not fully controlled.
The isolated probe batches backends and retains contexts; its per-context cold timings are not independent cold-process startup measurements.
Surface-field uploads/downloads are larger than routing-only transfers; phase fusion removes CPU work, not all host-device communication.
Stage-2's earlier 0.3-second/1% whole-run improvement estimate remains withdrawn.
decision: Keep the exact surface mode as an optional CLI research backend. Do not change GUI/CPU defaults or promise a large full-model acceleration.
